item.name: lite/button
item.title: Button
item.description: Base-ui button primitive with variant and size. Use for primary actions on forms and lists. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

item.name: lite/card
item.title: Card
item.description: Surface container (header, title, description, content). Use on detail pages and summary tiles such as a party's running balance. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

item.name: lite/field
item.title: Field
item.description: Form field layout (group, label, description). Use when building a party form or any labeled control cluster. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn and lite/label is present.

item.name: lite/input
item.title: Input
item.description: Base-ui text input primitive. Use on create/edit forms (party name, amounts). Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

item.name: lite/label
item.title: Label
item.description: Form label primitive. Use next to inputs; Field composes it. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

item.name: lite/table
item.title: Table
item.description: HTML table primitives for lists (parties, open balances, ledger lines). Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

item.name: lite/utils
item.title: cn helper
item.description: clsx + tailwind-merge `cn()` helper. Use when a component needs className merging. Assumes the base runtime serves clsx and tailwind-merge.
